title: After the Arima Kinen: And So the Wind Blows

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Ines Fujin, who loves running more than anyone, takes on the Arima Kinen—a race watched by countless racing fans—and wins in spectacular fashion.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The venue rumbles as the crowd chants her name. And she answers their calls directly.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Her family, friends, fans—they all see a dream in her. And Ines is enjoying that dream more than anyone…
